title: Contour Degree of Amoebas of Complete Intersections
summary: We establish the first universal upper bounds for the real degree of the contour of the amoeba of a smooth complete intersection in the algebraic torus. Our approach extends the Pfaffian method of Lang--Shapiro--Shustin from hypersurfaces to arbitrary codimension by introducing a logarithmic conormal framework based on the logarithmic conormal bundle, the logarithmic Grassmann map, and determinantal rank conditions.
